Forward: a G-successor necessarily satisfies G at every sibling by Euclideanness. Reverse: any G-successor would force G at the not-G-successor, a contradiction. Coverage uses explicit excluded middle on possible G; if possibility fails then all successors fail G. This proves sufficiency only, not a minimal frame characterization. S5 specialization reuses the K5 proof. Exclusivity needs an accessible world; reflexivity supplies one in S5. Fixed Bool controls certify S4 failure of both escalations and coverage despite the boxed conditional, universal S5 failure when only the actual conditional is supplied (also the omitted-premise control), empty/nonserial K5 with both necessities and neither possibility, disconnected identity S5 with opposite component necessities, and two constant universal models witnessing the rival possibilities separately. These are stipulated mathematical interpretations, not certified metaphysical possibilities. K5 necessity concerns successors and gives no actual G/not-G without reflexivity. Conditional necessity does not instantiate a divine essence, is not Scott individual NE, and is not a global metaphysical claim. The reverse rival remains fully available: neither possibility burden has been discharged.
